newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Most in HK predict Tung to win leadership - poll.
newsitem.headline: Most in HK predict Tung to win leadership - poll.

text.p: Most people in Hong Kong predict shipping tycoon Tung Chee-hwa will win the territory's contest for the first post-colonial chief executive, a new opinion poll showed on Tuesday.
In the survey conducted by Hong Kong University, 82.2 percent of those polled predicted that Tung would win the vote by the 400-member, China-controlled Selection Committee meeting on Wednesday.
Only 3.4 percent said they expected the nearest rival, former Chief Justice Ti Liang Yang, to win. A threadbare 0.3 percent tipped third-placed businessman, Peter Woo, as victor.

The telephone poll of 563 respondents conducted on Monday also found 43.4 percent of respondents would back Tung if they had the chance to vote. Yang would get 27.9 percent backing and Woo 5.1 percent.
Britain hands Hong Kong back to China at midnight next June 30, ending more than 150 years of colonial rule.
